article.title: The Regenerative Builder: The Mud, Sun & Slab Journal
article.description: Ishaan Bhargava's search for a genuinely sustainable home in Bengaluru — balancing embodied carbon, water neutrality, passive cooling, and startup founder bandwidth.
article.quote: "My house should compost, harvest, and breathe. Ideally before it impresses anyone."

learnings.text: Demand real performance utility bills over brochure green badges
Run total life-carbon including commute before choosing edge-of-city builds
Recognize founder bandwidth limits — buy focus now, phase the dream build to Plan 2031

tabs.name: Journey
tabs.label: Journey
tabs.title: How their journey actually unfolded.
tabs.description: From self-build spreadsheets to a bandwidth audit, a volunteer auditor position, and a pre-portal GoodEarth Malhar resale.

moments.title: The bandwidth audit
moments.desc: Self-build required 11 hrs/week × 18 months. Ishaan's startup needed those same 18 months. Path A's premium was renamed 'the price of focus'.
moments.imagegenerationprompt: A 3D vector illustration of a calendar ledger with 18 months highlighted in an 80% greyscale monochrome palette with a Warm Coral #DD5128 deadline stamp accent, Scandinavian minimalism, clean white background.

moments.title: The volunteer auditor
moments.desc: Joined GoodEarth Malhar sustainability group as volunteer auditor to inspect actual utility bills. The community network yielded a pre-portal resale.
moments.imagegenerationprompt: A 3D vector illustration of electric utility bills showing near-zero totals in an 80% greyscale monochrome palette with a Warm Coral #DD5128 verified checkmark accent, Scandinavian minimalism, clean white background.

moments.title: The 1-minute Lucknow speech
moments.desc: Told his mother: 'I'm buying a home where electricity bills are zero, and keeping a plot for the house I'll build us later.' Lucknow approved.
moments.imagegenerationprompt: A 3D vector illustration of a quiet phone call scene in an 80% greyscale monochrome palette with a Warm Coral #DD5128 audio signal accent, Scandinavian minimalism, clean white background.

quotes.text: The framework you built to judge houses just judged you — gently, I hope.

tabs.name: Start Here
tabs.label: Start Here
checklistItems: Your environmental convictions are quantified, audited, and personally binding.
You ask for electricity bills before floor plans, and the communities that share them proudly are your tell.
You're torn between buying the rare proven thing and building the pure thing.
Your actual bandwidth — not your values — is the binding constraint, and admitting it took a while.
The peri-urban purity option quietly prices in an isolation you preach against.
You want the house to persuade people, and you suspect comfort persuades better than argument.
